pricingAssumptions.availability: Owner rejected idle sleeping on 2026-10-21. Keep one replica running; conservatively bill all 744 hours of a 31-day month at the active rate without assuming idle discounts or a budget suspension. Restarts and deployments can still cause interruptions.
pricingAssumptions.budgetAutomation: Prepared hourly Consumption job using the QMT image and existing environment: 744 executions at 120 seconds, 0.25 CPU/0.5 GiB, no platform retries or free grants; USD 0.6696 compute. Add 0.02 GB logs (0.06578), one 15-minute log alert plus one resource series (0.55), and 3000 paid emails to one approved recipient (0.06). Total USD 1.34538/month is conditional, not a runtime/cost cap. No extra manual executions, duplicate jobs, additional recipients/channels, workflow or dedicated host assumed. Verify actual logs, alert rate/series/recipient configuration and complete charge scope. Templates and offline tests exist; Azure execution, KQL/notification delivery, maintenance messaging and actual stop/resume remain unverified. This is not a billing ceiling.
pricingAssumptions.registry: Public GHCR image; public-repository standard Ubuntu Actions runner; no uploaded build artifacts or paid builds. Existing npm cache must remain within the repository's included storage.
pricingAssumptions.logsAndMetrics: Fixed base only; scenario log ingestion is added separately at the paid Analytics Logs rate. Thirty-day retention, ordinary Analytics queries and platform metrics only; no paid alert rules, custom metrics, log export or Application Insights.
pricingAssumptions.networkAndEgress: Fixed base only; scenario outbound GB is charged separately at the first paid Microsoft Global Network rate. Same-region traffic; no NAT gateway, private endpoint, Front Door or WAF.
pricingAssumptions.backupAndRecovery: Fixed base only; add 10 GB-month LRS long-term backup storage and one 24-hour Basic restore database each month. The database template configures four-week weekly LTR and seven-day DTU PITR; deployment, actual backup volume and restoration remain unverified.
pricingAssumptions.sharedEnvironmentFeatures: Consumption profile only, with no incremental dedicated-profile management or paid environment features. Actual shared-environment configuration still requires review.
pricingAssumptions.dnsAndCertificates: Allow one new public Azure DNS zone plus scenario DNS queries, with a free managed certificate. Existing authoritative DNS and domain renewal are not yet verified; this is an allowance, not a DNS migration decision.
pricingAssumptions.traffic: All usage volumes are unmeasured scenario assumptions, not enforced limits. Revision-overlap stress doubles compute and per-replica logs, not aggregate HTTP requests, egress, DNS or the database.
pricingAssumptions.currencyAndExclusions: USD retail before taxes, contract pricing and currency conversion; no shared Azure free grants. No permanent second staging stack; separately approve any longer acceptance overlap or additional services.
